pins.title: How to Use a Sheet Mask: Easy Korean Steps

items.title: Cleanse and tone
items.body: Start on clean skin with a thin toner layer.

items.title: Smooth it on
items.body: Line up eyes and lips, press out air bubbles.

items.title: Set a timer
items.body: Usually 15 to 20 minutes, check the pack.

items.title: Pat, then moisturize
items.body: Pat leftover essence in, then a light cream.
